slides.say: Should you wrap everything in memo, use memo and use callback? Usually not.

slides.text: Coarse updates (replace a page)? Rarely needed. Granular (drag shapes)? Very helpful.
slides.say: If most interactions are coarse, like switching pages, memoization is usually unnecessary. In a drawing editor with granular moves, it can help a lot.

slides.text: Fewer needs: pass JSX as children, keep state local, keep render pure, avoid Effect chains.
slides.say: Many needs disappear if you pass JSX as children, keep state as local as possible, keep rendering pure, and avoid Effects that update state.

slides.text: Still laggy? Profile first, then memoize where it helps.
slides.say: If an interaction still feels slow, measure with the React DevTools profiler, and memoize where it matters.
